title: SimpleCore by Cooshh
description: A shared core library for Simple mods, providing common systems like economy support and shared utilities.
body:
# SimpleCore

SimpleCore is a shared core library for the Simple mod collection.

It provides common systems used by other Simple mods, such as economy/coin support, shared utilities, and integration helpers. SimpleCore is mainly a dependency mod and does not add much visible gameplay content by itself.

## Required by

- SimpleShop
- SimpleOreGen

## Features

- Shared economy/coin systems
- Common utility code
- Integration support for Simple mods
- Server and client support

## Notes

This mod is required for SimpleShop and SimpleOreGen to work correctly. Install SimpleCore on both the client and the server when using mods that depend on it.
